integrity: Proof uses a tree-leaf dominated-vertex reduction, an explicit good cover and nerve collapse, and an integral cellular product-square argument. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty tree factors, simple cycles with at least seven vertices, graph-vertex shortest-path metric, inclusive radius two. The proof gives a nonequivariant homotopy equivalence and a primitive first-homology kernel; no claim about higher scales or arbitrary fibers. Computational tests are finite corroboration and do not prove the universal theorem.
title: Tree-fiber cylinders retain exactly one integral Rips circle at scale two
